report_name: PAYLOAD Ransomware Abuses GPOs for Encryptionless Extortion

threat_actors.name: PAYLOAD
threat_actors.description: A new ransomware group observed using a novel encryptionless extortion technique by hijacking Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to change desktop wallpapers to a ransom note, combined with data exfiltration.
threat_actors.goals: To extort victims through business disruption and the threat of leaking exfiltrated data.

attack_patterns.name: Group Policy Modification
attack_patterns.description: The PAYLOAD group created a malicious Group Policy Object (GPO) named 'PAYLOAD' and linked it to the domain root to modify the desktop wallpaper registry key on all domain-joined machines.

attack_patterns.name: Domain Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attackers escalated privileges to the Domain Administrator level to gain the necessary rights to create and link a GPO at the root of the Active Directory domain.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors exfiltrated sensitive data from the victim's file servers to be used for double-extortion.

attack_patterns.name: Internal Defacement
attack_patterns.description: A malicious GPO was used to change the desktop wallpaper on all domain-joined systems to an image containing a ransom demand, serving as a visible defacement of internal systems.

malware.name: PAYLOAD Ransomware
malware.description: A ransomware toolset used by the PAYLOAD group. In this incident, it was used for an 'encryptionless extortion' attack, leveraging GPOs for defacement rather than performing file encryption.

identities.name: Middle Eastern manufacturing firm
identities.description: A manufacturing company in the Middle East targeted by the PAYLOAD ransomware group in April 2026.

indicators.name: Malicious GPO Creation via PowerShell
indicators.pattern:
title: Malicious GPO Creation via PowerShell
id: 2b8a1c9e-7d3f-4e6a-9b1c-8d7e6f5a4b3c
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a Group Policy Object with a suspicious name, as seen in PAYLOAD ransomware attacks.
references:
  - https://cypro.co.uk/insights/cyber-bulletins/payload-ransomware-hijacks-active-directory-gpo/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-21
tags:
  - attack.t1484.001
level: high
logsource:
  category: ps_script
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
      - "New-GPO -Name 'PAYLOAD'"
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the PowerShell command used to create the malicious 'PAYLOAD' GPO.

indicators.name: GPO Container Object Modification
indicators.pattern:
title: GPO Container Object Modification
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-2c1b-0a9f8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the modification of a Group Policy Container object in Active Directory, which could indicate malicious GPO hijacking.
references:
  - https://cypro.co.uk/insights/cyber-bulletins/payload-ransomware-hijacks-active-directory-gpo/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-21
tags:
  - attack.t1484.001
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 5136
    ObjectType: '{f30e3bc2-9ff0-11d1-b603-0000f80367c1}' # groupPolicyContainer
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects Windows Security Event ID 5136, indicating a directory service object was modified, specifically for groupPolicyContainer objects.

indicators.name: New GPO Folder Creation in SYSVOL
indicators.pattern:
title: New GPO Folder Creation in SYSVOL
id: 7d6c5b4a-3f2e-4d1c-0b9a-8f7e6d5c4b3a
status: experimental
description: Monitors for the creation of new folders within the SYSVOL Policies directory, which occurs when a new GPO is created.
references:
  - https://cypro.co.uk/insights/cyber-bulletins/payload-ransomware-hijacks-active-directory-gpo/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-21
tags:
  - attack.t1484.001
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\SYSVOL\'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\Policies\'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of new GPO folders in the SYSVOL share, which could be indicative of malicious GPO creation.
